profile.businessSummary: Nebius Group is building a full-stack AI cloud platform spanning GPU compute, storage, managed services, and software for model training, inference, and production deployment. The group also includes Avride and TripleTen and holds strategic stakes in other technology businesses.

businessLines.name: Nebius AI Cloud
businessLines.description: The core business: purpose-built AI cloud infrastructure, GPU clusters, storage, managed services, and developer tooling.

businessLines.name: Avride
businessLines.description: Autonomous driving and delivery-robot technology operating as a distinct group business.

businessLines.name: TripleTen
businessLines.description: Technology-focused education and reskilling business operating under its own brand.

businessLines.name: Strategic holdings
businessLines.description: Equity interests including ClickHouse and Toloka; ownership, accounting treatment, and liquidity can change over time.
